summary.text: Marianne Moore is a Republican member of the Maine Senate for Senate District 6, which covers all of Washington County and part of Hancock County.
The Senate page lists committee assignments to Health and Human Services, Marine Resources and Engrossed Bills.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Senate service in the 129th through 132nd Legislatures.
